_about: Backlog of Friday tool task guides: long-tail how-to and fix-it articles about one specific job in one tool we review. Each item: tool, pillar (category slug), kind ('How-to' or 'Fix it'), title, target_keyword (must be free in scripts/keyword_check.py), help_doc (the vendor's official help-center URL for the task; the source of truth for steps and menu names, fetched on the day of writing), status ('todo'|'done'|'skipped'), date, url, kd (Vettlo difficulty 20-100; 'kd_source': 'websearch estimate' when judged from the Google first page), note. Keep at least 6 'todo' items. Never plan '<tool> review/pricing/alternatives/vs' topics or login pages.
